description: This Java source file defines an abstract factory class for creating pub-sub (publish-subscribe) communication components using Akka actors, distributed data, and configuration. It includes nested classes for providing distributed data extensions, with methods to start distributed publishers and subscribers.

classes.name: AbstractPubSubFactory
classes.description: An abstract class for creating publish-subscribe components that encapsulates the creation of publisher and subscriber supervisors, and handles distributed data configuration.

classes.name: DDataProvider
classes.description: Provides configured instances of compressed distributed data extensions for the pub-sub system, specific to a cluster role.

classes.name: LiteralDDataProvider
classes.description: Provides configured instances of literal distributed data extensions, identified by cluster role and message type.

methods.name: startDistributedPub
methods.description: Initializes and starts a distributed publisher supervisor actor, returning a DistributedPub instance.

methods.name: startDistributedSub
methods.description: Initializes and starts a distributed subscriber supervisor actor, returning a DistributedSub instance.
